Name: Caroline's Sun Room Furniture
Author: dollynhoevida
Description:
Caroline shares the secrets for the perfect sun room, everything you need at ready and in the best condition. Pierre is helping his wife with the sales, you can find all the new stock by visiting Pierre's General Store.

To install you need to unzip the mod to your mods folder.

I also recommend [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12993]Aster and Nari's Japanese Wallpaper and Flooring[/url], it's beautiful!

This is my first furniture set for DGA (now Content Patcher), tell me if you find any bugs :D
